title: OP-06 triage response
description: One response per input row. Extra keys are tolerated; cost_usd and latency_ms, if supplied, are descriptive claims and require independent runtime measurement.

id.description: The input row's id, echoed back.

action.description: The next action, or 'none' when no action is permitted.

needs_human.description: Route to a person rather than act.
